copy.h1: California SuperLotto Plus Results and Winning Numbers
copy.intro: Find the latest California SuperLotto Plus winning numbers, search past drawings for a set of five numbers and a Mega number, explore the recorded history and read how the game works.
copy.jg02Body: Choose five numbers from 1 through 47 and one Mega number from 1 through 27. The Mega number is drawn from its own pool, so it may repeat one of your five.
copy.jg03Intro: A ticket checker for this game needs its published prize table, which has not been verified yet.
copy.jg04Intro: Ask about the latest drawing, how SuperLotto Plus works, the schedule, or the statistics shown on this page.
copy.jg05Intro: This game has one drawing per draw day.
copy.jg06Heading: How to play California SuperLotto Plus
copy.jg06Intro: Choose five different numbers from 1 through 47, then one Mega number from 1 through 27. The two groups are drawn separately and compared separately.
copy.jg07Intro: Browse past drawings. Every row keeps its own draw date and the rules that applied at the time.

methods.title: What buying more entries covers
methods.summary: Each SuperLotto Plus entry is compared with the drawing on its own.
methods.limitation: More entries is more chances at the published odds. It does not change how the drawing is conducted.

methods.title: Setting a fixed entertainment budget
methods.summary: Deciding an amount before you play, and treating it as the cost of entertainment, keeps play in proportion.
methods.limitation: No budget or number of entries changes the outcome of a drawing.
